{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.12

|gr1= GUI Control

|descr= Sets the current state of a [[CT_CHECKBOX]] control. Use {{hl|"CheckedChanged"}} control event handler with it.

|s1= control [[cbSetChecked]] state

|p1= control : [[Control]]

|p2= state : [[Boolean]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_myCheckBox cbSetChecked true;</sqf>
|x2= <sqf>
_disp = findDisplay 46 createDisplay "RscDisplayEmpty";
_chk = _disp ctrlCreate ["RscCheckBox", -1];
_chk cbSetChecked true;
</sqf>

|seealso= [[cbChecked]] [[ctrlSetChecked]] [[ctrlChecked]]
}}
